description: The playing track's structure laid against the video's cuts: BPM and bar length, the sections (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, outro and so on) with song and video times and loudness, the drop (where the full sound returns), separately when the beat comes in, the part of the song the video plays, and every shot with its start, its length in bars, the bar its cut lands on and which transitions its gap allows. Read it before a music-aware request such as transitions on the beat or at the drop, faster paced or ending on the last chorus. Only name drop or section times read here. For more interesting transitions, a speed ramp or dissolve (set_transition) on one or two cuts at section changes or the drop is usually enough; AI Seamless needs request_ai_seamless and the person's yes.
name: read_music_structure
title: Read the song's structure
